ashby:adaptivesecurity:1c44a646-5865-4e6.summary:
Adaptive is a cybersecurity startup on a mission to stop AI-powered cyberattacks. In December 2025, the company announced an $81M Series B led by NVIDIA and Bain Capital Ventures, with participation from Capital One Ventures, Citi Ventures, and continued support from Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), the OpenAI Startup Fund, and Abstract Ventures. sections.title: The Role
paras: We are growing our Customer Success team based out of our NYC office. The Customer Success Associate role is a foundational role with the autonomy to define and shape our customer onboarding and support processes from the ground up. You will act as the first line of defense for our clients—owning all aspects of implementation, onboarding, and technical support. As the “face of the product”, you will ensure customers see immediate and lasting value from our platform. You’ll partner directly with leadership and Engineering to rapidly troubleshoot issues, relay product feedback, and identify areas for improvement—ensuring a world-class experience for our users. This is an opportunity to make a significant impact, influence how we scale, and grow your career alongside a fast-moving, well-funded startup.

sections.title: Responsibilities
bullets: Own all aspects of customer implementation, onboarding, and support.
Conduct kick-off calls with new customers to ensure a successful setup and clear expectations.
Act as the first responder for customer-reported issues, providing prompt troubleshooting and ensuring timely resolutions.
Proactively monitor support channels (email, chat, etc.) and respond efficiently to customer inquiries.
Collaborate with Engineering to escalate and resolve complex incidents, surfacing broader product or platform health concerns as needed.
Partner with internal teams (Product, Design, Leadership) to continuously improve the customer experience, tools, and processes.
Act as the voice of the customer, providing product feedback and identifying gaps or new feature opportunities.
Strive to exceed customer expectations in response quality, timeliness, and overall satisfaction, ensuring customers achieve ongoing success with our platform.

sections.title: Qualifications

Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills
Excellent written and verbal communication skills and a customer-first mindset.
Demonstrated ability to multitask, prioritize, and thrive in a fast-paced startup environment.
A growth mindset and willingness to learn rapidly—both from customer interactions and from working closely with engineers and product managers.

ashby:astronomer:132a4732-ee65-4879-a445.summary: Astronomer empowers data teams to bring mission-critical software, analytics, and AI to life and is the company behind Astro, the industry-leading unified DataOps platform powered by Apache Airflow®. Astro accelerates building reliable data products that unlock insights, unleash AI value, and power data-driven applications. Trusted by more than 900 of the world’s leading enterprises, including Datadog, American Express, Expedia, Adobe, Autodesk, Together AI, and more, Astronomer lets businesses do more with their data. To learn more, visit www.astronomer.io .

sections.title: About the role
paras: The world’s most regulated companies, from global banks to healthcare systems, need a secure and reliable way to orchestrate the flow of mission-critical data. With 3,600+ contributors and 30 million downloads a month, Airflow is one of the most active projects in the history of the Apache Software Foundation, and the de facto standard for data orchestration. Astro Private Cloud (APC) lets regulated companies run managed Apache Airflow at scale inside their own infrastructure, meeting their security, compliance and data-residency requirements.

APC customers are among Astronomer’s largest: at one global retailer more than 1,000 data teams use it for workloads that cannot fail, everything from supply chain to payroll. They expect the same experience as our hosted platform, but their environments are locked down, sometimes air-gapped, and each one differs from the next. So some features need a different architecture to work here, and others exist only in APC.

As Staff Product Manager for APC, you’ll own its roadmap end to end. You’ll decide the strategy to make APC the obvious choice for even the most sophisticated open-source Airflow teams. You’ll work out which capabilities matter most to these customers, how to deliver them in environments we don’t control, and where APC should lead — including new AI pipelines. You’ll work with engineering to ship on dates customers can plan around, spend real time with customer executives, and partner closely with sales and services to keep our biggest accounts growing. And you’ll help build the foundational systems that our products will depend on for years.

sections.title: What you'll do
bullets: Set the vision and roadmap. Define and drive the strategy for APC, starting with the near-term goal of reaching feature parity with Astro Hosted.
Write the requirements. Specify a complex distributed platform that serves platform administrators, platform engineers, data engineers and AI teams.
Build alongside engineering. Work with R&D from design through release, including the infrastructure decisions that shape the product: Kubernetes, cloud environments, multi-tenancy and observability.
Listen to our most strategic customers. Engage executives and technical leaders on their security, compliance, certification and central-management needs, and use what you learn to prioritize.

Balance the few and the many. Weigh specific customer demands against a committed roadmap that serves the broader customer base. Push back where necessary, and work with forward-deployed engineers to deliver custom requirements.
Enable go-to-market teams. Support product marketing and sales with customer-focused messaging and content.
Be the voice of APC. Represent the product externally through conferences, webinars and written content.

sections.title: What you bring
bullets: Staff-level product experience. 8–9 years of product roles at enterprise data or infrastructure companies, with demonstrated experience driving product strategy and delivering impactful outcomes.
Technical depth. You can engage as a peer with engineering partners across R&D.
Platform knowledge. Working knowledge of cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes and the modern data stack.
Experience with demanding technical users. You've handled large, complex requests and have the judgment to weigh them against the product's overall roadmap.
Customer-facing presence. You're comfortable with executives and can turn customer input, product data and industry trends into a data-driven roadmap.
A bias to action. A record of delivering the product vision you set across multiple R&D teams.
Strong communication. You work well with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Public voice. You're comfortable speaking and writing publicly about technical products.

paras: As Director of Implementation , you will lead the team responsible for taking customers from signed contract through successful go-live—and for implementing new products, communities, acquisitions, and other expansions for customers already live on August Health.

We’re looking for someone who is equally comfortable leading a team, diving into the details, and building what doesn’t exist yet . You won't carry a traditional Implementation Manager book of business, but you should be capable of stepping into an implementation, understanding the customer and configuration, and helping drive it forward when needed.

paras: Lead and develop a high-performing Implementation team. Manage and coach Implementation Managers across both net-new and live-customer implementations, creating clarity around expectations, ownership, development, and performance. Build the team and organizational structure needed as August continues to grow.

Own the implementation experience from post-sale through go-live. Be accountable for the strategy and execution behind customer implementations across August's platform, ensuring customers launch successfully and are positioned for long-term success before transitioning to Customer Success. Our current IMs own the full cycle from discovery/configuration through go-live and early stabilization, so this leader needs to understand that work deeply.

Own implementation for customers as they grow and evolve. Oversee implementations for live customers adopting new products, adding communities through organic growth or acquisitions, navigating operator transitions, and otherwise expanding their use of August. These projects often require quickly understanding complex existing configurations and adapting them on accelerated timelines.

ashby:benchling:33c6c504-9ca4-4cae-8ebc-.summary:
We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era.

When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. AI has the potential to change this, compressing decades of R&D work into years. But that only happens when clean, structured scientific data and AI are built into how science gets done.

Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. Over 200,000 scientists around the world trust Benchling to power their most important work, from academic labs to Sanofi, Moderna, and more than half of the world's top 50 biopharma.

We’re building an AI scientist for our customers. We can’t do that if we haven’t built the muscle ourselves. AI fluency is…

sections.title: ROLE OVERVIEW
paras: Benchling's platform helps the world's largest biotech and pharma companies develop therapies faster. As a Product Manager on the Study Lifecycle team, you'll work on products such as Studies, Sample Testing, and Process Development that scientists use to do their jobs. These products are fundamental to how scientific work gets organized, planned, and connected to analysis across different phases of a drug's development cycle.

We launched Bioprocess in 2024 to help process development teams design, execute, and analyze the experiments that turn a molecule into a manufacturable drug. In 2025, we announced a partnership with Merck ( press release ) to help their teams develop and test vaccines faster by bringing their analytical workflows onto a single platform.

Today, we're implementing the largest pharma companies in the world on Bioprocess, making the core product better every quarter, and expanding into Analytical Sciences and downstream QC. Our vision is to become the software that helps biopharmas bring therapies to patients twice as fast.

sections.title: RESPONSIBILITIES
bullets: To inform what you build, you will spend time with customers and GTM teams to understand how scientists actually work, and how to turn what they ask for into what they need. It's your responsibility to bring that context back to the team and turn it into product direction.

You'll work alongside design, engineering, GTM, and our customers to build and ship products. That means guiding product decisions with design and engineering, validating ideas early with customers, enabling customer experience teams on what you ship, and partnering with GTM to bring it to market.

sections.title: QUALIFICATIONS
bullets: 5-7+ years of product management or equivalent experience

A diverse career history. You've worked across 2-3+ meaningfully different domains or product types. This is the single strongest signal we're looking for. It tells us you're a systems thinker who adapts, not someone who relies on one playbook.

Technical tool competency. You're resourceful. You use tools to help yourself and your team get work done, whether that's writing SQL queries to make data-driven decisions, using design tools to create prototypes, or using something like Cursor to ship product improvements directly.

Clear communication. You can lead an engaging professional conversation and keep a room's attention. You know how to adapt your communication style based on your audience and can read and respond to the individuals in the conversation. As a PM, this matters almost more than anything else.
Track record of outcomes. You've stayed long enough at key roles to ship, learn, and speak to what worked and what didn't. We're looking for evidence of impact.

Intellectual range. You're genuinely curious, and that curiosity shows up in how you learn and think about problems. Product management is a means to an end. It's how you apply the learnings from the curiosity that has driven you. What you and your team decide to build is an inevitable conclusion of that curiosity.

bullets: Experience in regulated or compliance-heavy industries (doesn't have to be life sciences)
Configuration-heavy, platform-style products
B2B SaaS in the growth/scaling stage
Prior life as an engineer, data scientist, or solutions consultant

sections.title: The Mission:
paras: Kong is building the future of AI connectivity, empowering developers to connect, secure, and scale their applications with speed and intelligence. We are hiring a Product Manager, Billing to lead the product and systems work behind how Konnect makes money: entitlements, metering, checkout, invoicing, provisioning, and the enterprise and marketplace motions that surround them.

In this role you are the product owner of Konnect's commercial operating layer: the systems that translate what Sales sells and what customers use into what ends up on an invoice. That means plan and entitlement design, the usage metering pipeline, self-serve checkout and subscription lifecycle, customer organization and billing admin experiences, enterprise billing workflows (CPQ sync, custom contracts), and cloud marketplace billing. You will work hand-in-hand with Product Growth, Pricing & Packaging, Finance, GTM, Sales, and Engineering.

This role reports to the Sr Director, Product (Platform) and sits at the intersection of two multi-year transformations: Kong's move from a single-product API gateway company into a multi-product enterprise, and Monetization's company-wide overhaul of pricing and packaging. The Billing, Provisioning, and Fulfillment program has historically been manual and relationship-driven. Your job is to turn it into a product, so Sales can sell more, Finance can bill more accurately, and customers get an experience that matches the quality of what they are paying for.

sections.title: What You’ll Do:
bullets: Platform Vision: Set a multi-year direction for how Konnect prices, meters, entitles, and invoices. Decide what becomes shared platform capability versus what stays feature-specific, and sequence delivery so near-term work lands without creating long-term drag.

Unified Entitlements: Build the entitlements model that determines what every customer can access within Konnect. Make entitlements a first-class concept that is consistently defined in contracts, enforced in-product, honored by provisioning, and reflected in billing.

Pricing & Packaging Delivery: Act as the product and systems counterpart to Monetization. Translate pricing and packaging decisions into production reality: configuring plans, reshaping metering, updating contracts, coordinating customer migrations, and making sure a rollout doesn't disrupt existing revenue.

Metering & Usage Visibility: Run the event pipeline, aggregation layer, and reporting experiences that show customers what they consumed and what they are being charged. Hold a financial-grade bar on accuracy, auditability, and reconcilability.

Checkout & Subscription Lifecycle: Own how customers self-serve onto a plan, change plans, renew, lapse, and recover. That covers plan discovery, checkout, the underlying payments integration, subscription state, retries and dunning, and the admin surfaces where customers manage their own billing.

Enterprise & Marketplace Motions: Connect Kong's enterprise sales and channel motions to the billing stack: CPQ-to-entitlement sync, bespoke contract handling, invoice-based billing, and marketplace billing across AWS, GCP, and Azure as we expand our presence there.

Fulfillment Automation: Replace today's manual, high-touch provisioning and fulfillment processes with productized, automated workflows. This includes migrating off our current metering and billing system onto a target stack that supports the new pricing and packaging framework.

Outcomes & Measurement: Define the health metrics for the domain, including net revenue retention, billing-driven churn, invoice dispute rate, collections aging, and billing support ticket load. Use them to set priorities and hold the team accountable for results.

sections.title: What You’ll Bring:
bullets: Have at least 6 years of product management experience in SaaS, with 2 or more spent directly in a billing, monetization, or pricing domain.
Can reason about the moving parts of a billing stack well enough to co-design the architecture with your engineering partner.

Have carried a pricing or packaging change from proposal through to production, including financial modeling, plan configuration, grandfathering logic, migrations, sales enablement, and customer communication.
Have built or scaled consumption-based monetization and understand the tradeoffs between simplicity, accuracy, and customer trust when metering drives the invoice.
Pull your own numbers when you need them (SQL, Snowflake, Hex, or equivalent) and use data to set priorities rather than to decorate decisions already made.
Have worked directly with Stripe or a metered billing platform (Metronome, Orb, OpenMeter), not through an engineer.

Have worked in or adjacent to API, infrastructure, or developer-platform products, and are comfortable with the technical context that comes with that territory.

You bring ambition and intellectual honesty to the work. You can hold a high bar while giving people room to grow. You care enough about customers to learn how they actually work, and you take responsibility for what happens after a product ships.

sections.title: What You’ll Do
bullets: Develop strong product leaders. Set clear expectations, coach through live work, address performance gaps, and support hiring and growth. Help PMs develop the judgment and confidence to lead increasingly difficult work.

Shape coherent product direction. Connect company priorities and customer needs to a clear point of view across your product areas. Make deliberate choices about what to pursue, sequence, test, or defer.

Deepen customer understanding. Work with users, domain experts, and field teams to understand operational workflows. Help PMs distinguish recurring needs from individual requests and find opportunities customers may struggle to articulate.

Advance product management with AI agents. Partner with Engineering and Design to test new approaches to discovery and development. Equip PMs to provide agents with useful context, define success, evaluate results, and exercise judgment where it matters.

Raise product quality. Help teams make sophisticated capabilities understandable and dependable. Challenge assumptions, review alternatives, and balance experimentation with the trust customers place in our software.

Build commitment across teams. Resolve dependencies and competing priorities with Engineering, Design, and Product Operations. Clarify ownership and bring larger tradeoffs to leadership with a recommendation.

Follow through on outcomes. Define success before delivery and learn from adoption, customer feedback, and business results. Change course when the evidence shows that a different approach would create more value.

ashby:openai:fd5522f1-8e39-4d60-8b8a-34f.summary:

OpenAI’s mission is to build safe artificial general intelligence (AGI) which benefits all of humanity. This long-term undertaking brings the world’s best scientists, engineers, and business professionals into one lab together to accomplish this.

In pursuit of this mission, our Go To Market (GTM) team is responsible for helping customers learn how to leverage and deploy our highly capable AI products across their organization. The team comprises Sales, Solutions, Support, Marketing, and Partnership professionals who collaborate to create valuable solutions that will help bring AI to as many users as possible.

ashby:prefect:943b33ab-ff38-42c6-aa5d-08.summary:

ashby:propel:0bc0101a-f096-4f46-a7d7-cf8.summary:
Propel builds technology that strengthens the social safety net in America. We envision a future where every American has the tools and resources they need to thrive.

The safety net’s strength depends not just on funding, but delivery. Propel exists to dramatically improve how government benefits are delivered. Managing SNAP benefits, picking a D-SNP plan, or protecting against EBT theft should feel as seamless as Apple Pay or Netflix.

Governments struggle to build modern, scalable user experiences. We don’t.

Over 5 million Americans trust Propel today. We’ve grown revenue 35% YoY and are reinventing entire benefit categories, including Medicare, around the real needs of low-income Americans. We’re building a high-growth, high-ceiling, sustainable for-profit company where impact drives revenue.

paras: Propel is launching new products that expand how we help SNAP recipients save money and access essential services. We’re looking for a Product Marketing Manager to help bring these products to market and grow their reach.

This role will focus on consumer products and features that help SNAP recipients save on groceries and everyday essentials—from Rewards and Deal Tracker to offers across our Marketplace. You’ll develop positioning and messaging, shape go-to-market and ongoing marketing strategies, and partner closely with Product, Lifecycle, Growth, Research, and business leads to drive discovery, activation, and repeat engagement. You’ll report to the Director of Product Marketing.

sections.title: What You’ll Do
bullets: Build a deep understanding of our audiences—their needs, motivations, perceptions, and sources of confusion—and use those insights to shape product and marketing decisions.
Define and test differentiated positioning, value propositions, naming, and messaging.
Write clear, compelling customer-facing copy for product launches and lifecycle communications.
Lead go-to-market and lifecycle plans that drive discovery, activation, and repeat engagement.
Bring audience and market insight into product development, from early strategy through launch and iteration.
Define success measures, design experiments, and use adoption, engagement, conversion, and revenue data to evaluate impact and adjust the strategy.

sections.title: What You Bring
bullets: 5+ years of experience in product marketing or a closely related role, ideally in a consumer technology environment.
Exceptional writing skills and the ability to make complex products clear, compelling, and trustworthy.
A track record of developing positioning and messaging and leading go-to-market strategy for new or evolving products.
Hands-on experience writing lifecycle communications that support onboarding, engagement, retention, or reactivation.
Strong audience orientation and a practical approach to using qualitative and quantitative insights to make decisions.
A track record of setting measurable goals, designing experiments, and using adoption, engagement, conversion, and revenue data to evaluate impact.
Comfort operating autonomously in a fast-moving environment, creating structure from ambiguity, adapting as priorities shift, and building buy-in across teams.

ashby:reevo:5431ca1c-f937-480b-acf9-b988.summary:
At Reevo, we're reimagining the entire revenue stack from the ground up, and we're doing it with speed. We're building software that orchestrates every go-to-market motion, enabling B2B teams to operate faster, smarter, and more collaboratively. By combining automation, intelligence, and a radically intuitive interface, we're helping companies unlock new levels of productivity and growth across marketing, sales, ops, and customer success teams.

If you're excited about working on a product that reshapes how revenue teams work and being surrounded by curious, driven teammates, you'll feel right at home here. From day one, you'll get real ownership, real mentorship, and real impact. Our team of 100+ builders have over 30 exits under their belt, so you'll be in good company, and working alongside the best!

sections.title: The Opportunity:
paras: Forward Deployed Generalist is how Reevo comes to life inside a customer's revenue team — from the first day of deployment to a team that can't imagine selling without it. Plenty of customers want more than the software — they want a partner who gets them fully live, fast. You sit at the intersection of the product, the customer's go-to-market motion, and the people actually using it — turning a customer's messiest, highest-stakes rollout into a revenue team that runs on Reevo.

You own that delivery end to end, and the one number you own is time to value. This is a fast-paced, high-mobility role built for a high-slope builder — you move fast, take on more as fast as you can earn it, and there's no ceiling on how far you go. Expect to be deeply embedded with customers , sitting in the messy middle of how revenue teams really work, surfacing process pain points and turning them into a prescriptive deployment that actually sticks. You’ll be based on-site in San Francisco and travel to customers for onsite sprints.

We care a lot about building a strong in-person culture, and we’re very much in build mode. We expect the team to be in our SF office five days a week — that’s important to how we operate and scale right now.

sections.title: Who you are:
bullets: High-slope. We hire for slope, not intercept — how fast you climb matters more than what you already know.

A customer-first implementer. You genuinely care whether the customer's business wins — not just whether the go-live checklist is done. You thrive where technology meets business process, mapping workflows and turning messy requirements into clean solutions.
A prescriptive advisor. You don't just take orders; you tell customers what good looks like and guide them to it.
Technically fearless. Comfortable in spreadsheets and light scripting today; you want to learn SQL, APIs, and integrations fast.
A curious builder. You're driven to improve systems, find efficiencies, and get more technical over time.

sections.title: What you'll do:
bullets: Own the deployment end to end. Take a customer from "signed" to a revenue team running its daily motion on Reevo — you own the outcome, not a checklist.

Handle the technical glue. Wire up the integrations — lead forms, webhooks, quick data syncs — with a bit of scripting. Partner with Forward Deployed Software Engineers on anything that needs production code. You'll scope it, they'll build it, and you'll learn the pattern.
Own the data migration. Map, import, and QA the customer's data so day-one trust is earned, not lost.
Drive adoption. Get users into the product, run the training, and kill the hundred small reasons a rep hasn't logged in yet.
Make the next one faster. Turn every deployment into a repeatable playbook — and every successful customer into a reference.

Demonstrated ability to lead complex software implementations end-to-end
Strong consultative skills—able to diagnose customer needs and translate them into product configurations
Proficiency with data management, integrations, and system configuration
Strong communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills across technical and executive stakeholders
Experience working with CRM platforms (Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar)

ashby:remarcable-inc:578c1ba3-d29e-456a-.summary:
Remarcable is intelligent procurement and material operations for commercial specialty contractors and the distributors who supply them. We connect the field, the office, and suppliers on one platform, so everyone works from the same information from the first requisition to the last invoice. Every part. Every order. Every team. Finally connected.

We come from the trade. Our team includes manufacturers, distributors, contractors, and construction technologists, with more than 100 years of combined experience. We know the chaos well: scattered orders, re-keyed POs, overcharges caught three weeks too late, and a field and office working from different information. We are pro-distributor and supplier-neutral. Our job is to make the counter easier to run and the contractor relationship stronger.

sections.title: About Remarcable
paras: Today Remarcable connects over 250 MEP contractors to more than 1,300 distributors and over 8,600 integrated branches, with more than $1 billion in material moving through the platform every month.

sections.title: About the role
paras: We're building for distributors, and we're hiring a Senior Product Marketing Manager to be on the core team for this new go-to-market. This is not a role that inherits a launch calendar. You'll help decide who we build for, what problem we lead with, and how we talk about.

You'll work side by side with product, engineering, sales, supplier success, and our distributor customers. The products, the positioning, and the go-to-market programs are all still being written, and you'll write a good part of them. Distributors run a different business than contractors, with branches, counter staff, outside sales, and margins measured in points. You'll learn that business well enough to talk shop at the counter and in the boardroom.

sections.title: What you'll do
bullets: Get out to the branches and the main office. Run customer discovery with distributor owners, operations leaders, inside and outside sales, and counter staff, and bring what you hear back to Product.
Define the ideal customer and the buyer. Sort which distributors we serve first, by size, trade, and how they sell today.
Write the positioning and messaging for new distributor products from a blank page, in partner language. We make their counter easier and their contractor relationships stronger.
Shape pricing and packaging with leadership. Test it with early customers and refine it as the market answers.
Plan and run the first launches: beta and early-access programs, launch plans, and the story for each release.
Partner with sales on the first sales playbook, including the pitch, demo flow, objection handling, and discovery questions. Then enable the reps who carry it.
Turn early customers into proof. That means pilots with clear success measures, case studies, and the numbers distributors care about: orders handled, disputes avoided, and hours back at the counter.
Map the competitive field for distributor technology, including ERPs, ecommerce platforms, and homegrown tools, and show where we fit.

sections.title: Why Remarcable
paras: Please be aware of potential phishing scams . Remarcable will never advance job applicants money or ask them to send money (via Venmo, Zelle, Paypal etc.) to preferred vendors. If you are concerned about the application process, please contact Remarcable directly at (216)770-3322.
Remarcable is not associated with info-remarcable.com . For information about applying for a position with Remarcable, please reference remarcable.com .
bullets: Build product marketing at Remarcable from the ground up.
Shape go-to-market for a company doubling revenue year over year.
Join a team that values creativity and accountability, and does work that matters to the people who build the communities we live, work, and play.

ashby:snyk:d3d79aec-d45b-4428-ac0d-45739.summary:
Software is being rewritten in real time. AI agents are starting to write more code than humans do, at a speed no security team has ever had to match, and that single shift is opening up the biggest opportunity our industry has seen in a decade. We're not bracing for it, we're building the company that owns it.

Snyk is building the next generation security platform where security isn't a set of tools people operate. It's a team of security agents working alongside your engineers, finding, fixing, and governing risk at the speed software is now built. These agents work alongside both the company build and the agents they adopt. Security stops being a queue of work waiting for people, and becomes a coordinated workforce companies direct and trust.

sections.title: Why this role?
paras: As an Account Director at Snyk, you’ll be responsible for the end-to-end sales and success cycle for prospective and existing Enterprise customers who are focused on Digital Transformation. You will have the privilege of interacting with customers at the most senior level of the Security and Engineering organizations.

You’ll join a team that is resilient, business savvy, and curious, where we see the value our product offers and want it to be part of every software development process. Capitalizing on your territory knowledge, you will utilize connections in the market to grow your account base and help drive our mission to embed security into every part of the AI-native development lifecycle.

sections.title: What You’ll Do:
bullets: Own the end-to-end sales cycle for large Enterprise customers, responsible for prospecting, selling, and retaining customers.
Build and nurture strong relationships with key stakeholders and C-Level Executives within Security and Engineering organizations.
Collaborate cross-functionally with leadership, customer success, channel partners, marketing, product, and finance to drive deals and ensure customer success.

Develop complex account plans that incorporate multiple lines of business, channel ecosystems, and executive coverage models to build a dual-speed business of smaller/faster-moving accounts and larger/complex accounts.
Manage renewal and expansion for your customer base, ensuring long-term outcomes and partnership growth.
Forecast with accuracy and detail for both short and long-term opportunities while proactively mitigating close-lost rates.

sections.title: What You Bring:
bullets: Significant Enterprise Sales Experience: You have a minimum of 5 years experience owning the entire sales cycle for a technical product on Enterprise level accounts (Fortune 1000).
Proven Track Record: You are self-motivated and hard-working with a history of exceeding your quota and closing million-dollar+ ARR transactions.

Domain Expertise: You’ve excelled at selling into Cybersecurity, DevOps, or DevSecOps groups, or have significant enterprise software sales experience generating and closing large & complex transactions.
Strategic Collaboration: You leverage your ecosystem internally and externally, understanding that selling is a team sport at Snyk where managing virtual resources is a must-have skill.
Executive Presence: You practice extreme ownership, are skilled in navigating complex organizations, and possess the ability to engage confidently with C-Level Executives.
Consultative Approach: You possess strong consultation skills to work with multiple levels within a customer organization to address business challenges.

sections.title: About Snyk
paras: Snyk is committed to creating an inclusive and engaging environment where our employees can thrive as we rally behind our common mission to make the digital world a safer place. From Snyk employee resource groups, to global benefits that help our employees prioritize their health, wellness, financial security, and a work/life blend, we aim to support our employees along their entire journeys here at Snyk.

Making electrification upgrades possible

sections.title: Responsibilities

ashby:sprinter-health:61461da9-9082-4c22.summary:
At Sprinter Health, our mission is reimagining how people access care by bringing it directly to their homes. Nearly 30% of patients in the U.S. skip preventive or chronic care simply because they can’t get to a doctor’s office. For many, the ER becomes their first touchpoint with the healthcare system—driving over $300B in avoidable costs every year.

By using the same technologies that power leading marketplace and last-mile platforms, we deliver care where people are, especially those who need it most. So far, we’ve supported more than 2 million patients across 22 states, completed 130,000+ in-home visits, and maintained a 92 NPS . Our team of clinicians, technologists, and operators have raised over $125M to date investors like a16z, General Catalyst, GV, and Accel and enjoy multi-year runway.

sections.title: About The Role:
paras: We're building the AI and clinical services stack to make preventive, connected healthcare accessible for everyone in the US. We deliver hybrid care (in-home + virtual) powered by an AI platform that unlocks the seemingly impossible: broad reaching care across 25+ states, serving 70%+ of the US population that’s always-on and very margin efficient. This core care delivery foundation has also opened up the door to major enterprise AI offerings that further cement the value Sprinter can provide. Because of our differentiated offering and impact, all of the major health plans in the country are proud customers. With 2M+ patients and 90+ NPS, we're rapidly scaling our impact far beyond where we are today. Our team of engineers, AI scientists, clinicians, and operators is backed by investors including a16z, General Catalyst, GV, and Accel that have backed companies like Devoted Health, Abridge, Livongo, Benchling, Stripe, Ramp, Airbnb, Cursor, Instagram, and Databricks.

sections.title: Your mission, if you choose to accept:
paras: As a Senior Product Manager, Clinical Platform , your true north star will be to increase patient access to Sprinter Health services by building the platform for composable, configurable healthcare that is the foundation for AI-native healthcare and impact at scale .

Every service we deliver, in every state, by every type of clinician, is composed from a small set of primitives. You will own those primitives: the validated patient record, the service catalog and the composition grammar that defines what a service requires and how services combine, and the authoring surface that lets a range of users stand up a new care pathway without filing an engineering ticket. You will have a broad impact surface area across 25+ states, 2M+ patients, first-party and contracted clinical supply, health plan customers, and a growing roster of clinical vendor partners.
You are the key architect, builder, and strategist of this layer.
bullets: Defining how care composes at a platform level: What a service requires, what it produces, and how services combine across licensure, modality and supply source. This is the object that decides whether our tenth care pathway takes a month of engineering or an afternoon of configuration.

Building the authoring surface for non-engineers and AI agents: Clinical strategy composes a new pathway, partnerships configures a new partner, and neither files a ticket. AI agents compose a bespoke patient pathway with zero engineering changes in any team.

Owning our extended networks platform: You will be DRI for an exciting new initiative where we are bringing external clinical partners on-platform to expand our reach from a geography and service mix perspective while ensuring the same level of impact, quality, and patient experience of our first-party offerings.

sections.title: What you have done:
bullets: Proven track record: 6+ years of product management experience, including at least two owning platform, infrastructure or API products that other engineering teams built on.

Configurability, as a requirement and not a preference: You have taken hard-coded behavior and abstracted it to make it data-driven and configurable. You can tell us what you parameterized, what you deliberately refused to, and what broke when a config was wrong.

Modeling and contract judgment: You have designed a core entity and its lifecycle, shipped versioned interfaces, and deprecated something other teams depended on. You have seen both failure modes: the rules engine only its authors can operate, and the model so rigid that every new partner needs code.

Culture carrier: Preferred development and growth path is by ambitiously setting vision, prioritizing, and driving impact as a team with a true north centered on patient impact. Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment and scrub-in across team needs, even when they sit outside of your role description or job title.

sections.title: Bonus points if you have:
bullets: Startup experience, especially those that have gone through rapid growth.
Shipped a rules engine, policy editor, or pathway builder that non-engineers used in production.
A favorite Lord of the Rings character.

ashby:superpower:c40f0e7f-e0b2-4ffc-9ff3.summary:
Superpower is building a new personalized health system aimed to enhance human life: powered by comprehensive biomarker and diagnostic testing, personalized insights, action plans, and a clinical care team, delivered as a population health and wellbeing benefit.

This is the founding product marketing hire, and it is a builder's role, not a manager's. The hard part is not running campaigns or a team. It is making a complex clinical and commercial product legible and compelling to sophisticated buyers who evaluate rigorously. You own how we position Superpower, how we package it, and how we prove it. If you get that right, everything downstream of it gets easier.

sections.title: What you'll do
bullets: Own positioning and messaging for employers, health plans, brokers, and consultants. Make Superpower legible to a benefits buyer in their own language, and sharp against the alternatives.
Build the proof engine: case studies, outcomes narratives, and credibility assets that hold up to clinical and actuarial scrutiny.
Own packaging and pricing narrative in partnership with Product and commercial leadership: how we structure, name, and present what we sell.
Be the voice of the customer. Sit in member and client data and insight, and feed it back into positioning, packaging, and the product roadmap.
Build the content strategy and the enablement that closes: decks, one-pagers, objection handling, and category framing for Sales and the channel.
Partner closely with Product, Sales, and Client Success. You see positioning, product, and the sales motion as one system.

sections.title: Who you are
bullets: 6+ years in product marketing or customer marketing, with real 0-to-1 ownership of positioning, packaging, and launch for a complex, high-consideration product.

A genuine craft-deep IC. You write the positioning, build the deck, and ship the content yourself. You are not looking to manage a team right now, you are looking to do the best work of your career hands-on.

A storyteller who is also rigorous with data. You can build a sharp narrative and an honest, defensible proof story from real-world evidence. At the same time you push the market on new approaches and reimagining what healthcare should look like.

sections.title: About Superpower
paras: Superpower is a new health system on a mission to extend and enhance human life.

Over the past 6 months, we have grown 10x whilst halving CAC. Now we are gearing up for hyper growth.

sections.title: Company Philosophies
bullets: We are all here to genuinely do our life’s best work
Insanely high talent bar, never settling. A players only ( see Steve Jobs )
We live to work as much as we work to live. But we sustainably espouse the superpower ethos of putting health first
We aim to set the gold standard for team health culture on the planet — live the ethos!

ashby:tabs:ffd005a7-5f15-41be-b398-a2551.summary: Tabs is the AI Operating System for Revenue, built for modern finance and accounting teams. Tabs understands customer and contract context, applies accounting logic, and executes critical workflows with built in controls, auditability, and human oversight. With Tabs, finance teams can move from manually managing revenue workflows to directing outcomes while the system executes the work.

sections.title: About the Role
paras: As a Customer Success Manager at Tabs, you’ll bring proven customer success expertise to elevate the experience of finance and AR leaders running their business on our AI-powered platform. This role demands strong communication and relationship-building skills. You'll be the trusted voice customers turn to as they navigate change. sections.title: What You’ll Do

Manage a portfolio of customers, acting as the primary point of contact for adoption, escalation, and renewal.

Gather, synthesize, and communicate customer feedback and feature requests to Product
and cross-functional teams.

Data-driven: experience using SQL, BI tools, and metrics to shape account strategy and measure outcomes.
Organized, prioritizes effectively, and able to independently solve complex problems.

sections.title: Additional Information
paras: This role is based in New York City 5 days a week in our Soho office.

ashby:tempo-io:4f923675-99b4-4527-8f3c-1.summary:
With over 30,000 customers, including a third of Fortune 500 companies, Tempo is trusted by organizations across the globe to make their workflows work better.

We create a suite of integrated solutions for time management, resource planning, budget management, roadmapping, program management, reporting and more. We create the tech that enables the modern team to deliver – for every step from first vision to value.

Since our beginning in 2007 as a project to make a time-tracking tool to help a client – Tempo has expanded to become the #1 time management add-on for Jira, and we have developed and acquired a multitude of tools to become one of the most trusted names in the Atlassian ecosystem.

sections.title: About Tempo Workforce Intelligence
paras: Tempo Workforce Intelligence is our newest product and one of our most ambitious bets: the opportunity to define how enterprises measure and manage the value of AI-powered work. Engineering organizations are investing in AI faster than they can account for it. Provider invoices show what was spent, but not what it delivered, leaving leaders to make high-stakes investment and governance decisions from incomplete evidence.

Workforce Intelligence changes that by connecting AI telemetry to the Jira work items, epics, and initiatives where funded work is managed. As it extends across Tempo's suite, it can become the execution-layer system of record for AI return on investment, helping engineering leaders evaluate tools and models using their own data, see where AI changes delivery, and act on what they learn.

The foundation is in place, but the category is still being defined. What evidence will a VP of Engineering trust in a board conversation? How should companies benchmark rapidly changing tools and govern agent-only work? You will answer those questions with design partners, shape the standard, and own the trajectory from customer experiments to the adoption, retention, and revenue that make Workforce Intelligence a business Tempo is known for.

sections.title: About the Role
paras: We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead Workforce Intelligence from an emerging product into a durable business. You will own the strategy, roadmap, and commercial outcomes for the product. Success will be measured through adoption, retention, and revenue, not the volume of features shipped.

This is a role for someone who is at their best when the category, customer need, and answer are still taking shape. You will form clear hypotheses, test them with customer data, and change course when the evidence does not hold up. You will work directly with engineering leaders, then bring what you learn back to a cross-functional team spanning engineering, design, sales, marketing, customer success, finance, and other Tempo product teams.

You will need to earn alignment rather than rely on authority. The strongest candidate can turn technical ambiguity into a clear product decision, connect a roadmap to a business result, and explain what AI delivers in language a customer or executive can trust.

sections.title: What You'll Do
paras: We build in small, dedicated teams. You'll work directly with engineering and design from problem definition through shipped features, with minimal handoff and maximum ownership. We use AI collaboratively throughout our own work to streamline communication and accelerate delivery.
bullets: The Workforce Intelligence strategy and roadmap, with clear bets tied to activation, adoption, retention, and revenue.
Run continuous discovery with CTOs, VPs of Engineering, engineering managers, and design partners to understand how they evaluate AI tools, productivity, spend, and risk.
Turn uncertain customer problems into testable hypotheses. Prototype quickly, run experiments with real customer data, and stop work that does not earn further investment.
Lead the evolution of trusted attribution and reporting, from AI activity and cost at the work-item level to executive narratives about throughput, delivery dates, capacity, and savings.

Develop Tempo's point of view on agent oversight, including how organizations identify agent-only work, connect it to funded initiatives, explain its cost, and review results with appropriate context.
Shape tool and model benchmarking that reflects a customer's own teams and work, with transparent methods and confidence rather than broad vendor claims.
Set the connector and data strategy across AI providers, developer environments, source control, work management, collaboration tools, and Tempo's own products.
Partner with the Product Managers for Timesheets, Capacity Planner, and Financial Manager to create connected customer value while keeping product ownership and sequencing clear.

sections.title: What Success Looks Like
paras: In the first year, success looks less like a shipped feature list and more like a set of relationships and decisions that didn't exist before you got here.
bullets: You'll have shipped attribution and reporting that a VP of Engineering trusts enough to bring into a board conversation, measured by real adoption and retention among early adopters.
You'll have a validated point of view on agent governance and benchmarking, tested against customer data rather than assumption, that shapes where the product goes next.
You'll have a small portfolio of experiments run with real design partners that killed at least one idea the team believed in and replaced it with one the data actually supported.
You'll be the person sales, marketing, and customer success turn to for the story on what AI delivers, because you own both the roadmap and the results.

ashby:unlearn:77277b21-ca29-4eb2-b54a-64.summary:
Every day, people are waiting for a diagnosis, for a treatment, for a chance. Our mission is to help life-saving treatments reach patients faster.

That isn’t an abstraction to us. It’s the reason Unlearn exists, and it’s why the pace and rigor of our work matter so much.

sections.title: What We Do
paras: Unlearn is transforming clinical development by making every trial smarter. We partner with biopharmaceutical companies to redesign how clinical trials are planned, conducted, and analyzed. We use data, AI, and digital twins to make studies faster and more robust.

A digital twin is a comprehensive prediction of a patient’s expected outcomes under a defined standard of care. It is generated by machine learning models built on our proprietary technology. Leading pharma and biotech companies trust us to deliver scientifically rigorous work on studies where the stakes are high and the timelines impact patients.

sections.title: Where We’re Going
paras: Our goal is to become the gold standard for AI-driven clinical development. Getting there takes disciplined execution and data, models, and AI that is implemented with partners using a strong engineering foundation that holds up in a regulated, compliance-heavy environment. We’re building durable advantages rooted in science and innovative technologies, and that foundation is what will make our leadership last.

sections.title: About Unlearn
paras: Unlearn was founded in 2017 by a team of world-class machine learning scientists and is headquartered in San Francisco. We’re backed by top-tier investors including Altimeter, Insight Partners, Radical Ventures, 8VC, and DCVC. We have substantially advanced AI technology for clinical trials, including regulatory-grade applications, and are embedded in multiple clinical trials with top Pharma and Biotech companies.

sections.title: About the role
paras: We are building the gold standard workbench for Digital Twins in clinical development. That process starts with data. Clinical and healthcare data is messy, low information, and in many different formats. In order to realize the value the Digital Twins can offer, model building needs reliable data to build on.

You will own the area of the product that makes this happen. You will design and ship the parts of the workbench where people bring in and harmonize data, with AI agents taking on more of the mapping, checking, and cleanup, and people reviewing, correcting, and approving what the agents do. Underneath sits a knowledge layer: an ontology that records what our data means and how it connects. It is at an early stage, and it is intended to become what our agents rely on to do scientific work well. You will help shape it from the product side.

Your first users are our own scientists and services team, and you will work alongside them. The same tools will then move into customers' hands, so what you build is a core part of what Unlearn offers. You will work closely with engineers, designers, and scientists, and with the VP of Product, who sets overall direction with you.

ashby:valon:68d7deeb-b40b-4ede-9144-0003.summary:
Valon is the leading AI platform for mortgage servicing, building the AI-native operating system for regulated finance.

Before providing the system of record that powers the entire industry, we built and ran our own mortgage servicer on it. That gave us a real regulated environment to prove our technology could replace the mainframe systems servicers have used for decades. Carrington acquired that servicer and adopted ValonOS as its core platform, allowing us to focus entirely on scaling our SaaS platform.

ValonOS is now on track to power 1 in 6 U.S. mortgages across major mortgage servicers like Newrez, Carrington, and ServiceMac. Every process on the platform is structured and programmable, enabling our AI agents to perform core servicing work, like handling payments, escrow, and homeowner questions, directly within the system's controls.

sections.title: About the Role
paras: Valon is rebuilding the mortgage servicing industry from the ground up. We're looking for a Data Implementation Manager to join our team and help us coordinate and launch complex data workstreams as part of our enterprise deployments that will revolutionize how mortgage servicers operate.

In this role, you'll be instrumental in coordinating efforts across multiple internal teams (data, deployment strategy, engineering, product) and numerous client stakeholders, ensuring seamless communication, and driving the successful delivery of our most critical initiatives.

Within Mortgage Servicing, data is the lifeblood of a company’s day to day operations. There are substantial reporting requirements and a strong business need for robust internal controls. Data is one of the primary drivers to the quality of overall servicing operations and operating efficiency.

sections.title: What You’ll Do
bullets: Lead End-to-End Data Migration: Lead data workstreams on client engagements to ensure data is properly migrated and critical reports and data assets are ready for go-live.

Drive Cross-Functional Coordination: Facilitate effective communication and collaboration between data, deployment strategy, engineering, product, and other stakeholders to ensure alignment and shared understanding.
Optimize Deployment Processes: Proactively identify and implement process improvements to drive efficiency, predictability, and scalability as we grow our deployment motion.

Manage Complex Stakeholder Dynamics: Organize, structure, and drive complex deployment workstreams. Proactively communicate program status, risks, and dependencies to all relevant stakeholders, ensuring transparency and alignment.
Mitigate Risks and Resolve Issues: Identify potential roadblocks and actively work to resolve technical, operational, and organizational challenges that may impact program delivery.
Define and Track Metrics: Establish clear success metrics for programs and regularly track progress, providing data-driven insights to inform decision-making.

sections.title: What You'll Bring
bullets: 5+ years of experience as an Implementation Manager, Customer Success Manager, or PM in a fast-paced, complex software development environment.
Experience at companies deploying software, AI, or technology at large enterprises. Experience with long-term (6+ month) implementation or business transformation projects is a plus.
Proven track record of successfully delivering large-scale, cross-functional technical programs.
Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC) and various agile methodologies.
Conceptual understanding of fundamental data concepts (schemas, databases) to be conversant with technical stakeholders at clients
Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and align diverse stakeholders.
Excellent problem-solving abilities and a proactive approach to identifying and mitigating risks.
Ability to thrive in a dynamic, rapidly evolving startup environment.

ashby:vantageanalytics:ce82fe0a-91aa-454.summary:
Vantage is looking for a Director, Customer Support and Enablement (CSE) to lead our support and enablement team within Solutions & Delivery. Reporting to the VP of Solutions & Delivery, you will own service reliability and platform adoption for our enterprise retail media partners. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

sections.title: About the Role
paras: We're hiring the first Dashboard & Configuration Product Manager Cloudflare's Web Integrity & Trust product suite. More than 50% of Internet traffic is automated. Knowing who's human, who's an agent, and who's a malicious actor is core to Cloudflare's strategy, and one of the primary values we sell to our customers.Cloudflare sits in front of more than 20% of the web. That vantage point lets us detect automated threats, fraud, and traffic manipulation at a scale and depth no one else can match. Turning that raw signal into something a human can understand, trust, and act on is one of the most interesting design problems in security today — and it's the problem you'll own.

Our products make probabilistic decisions in an adversarial environment. “Is this traffic truthfully representing who they are?” and "Can we trust this traffic?" doesn't have a clean yes-or-no answer. Our objective is to minimize risk without ever having ground truth. Your job is to make that kind of reasoning legible and controllable to the people who rely on it, from the security analyst running an investigation to the marketing team trying to understand the performance of their most recent campaign.

This role spans the full arc of how customers work with our product suite, from navigation, configuration, exploring and investigating their traffic, to proving the value of what Cloudflare's network sees. Today those experiences live in disconnected places; a core part of this role is envisioning the coherent product they should become. This role will work directly with the Director of Product and across the PMs who lead each product line

You don't need a security background, but you need the mind and craft to go deep in one fast.
You use AI fluently in your own craft, and you have the judgment to know where it accelerates the work and where it falls short.
You bring independent design conviction. You've originated solutions in spaces with little prior art, and you can clearly articulate why a design is right, or why you're pushing back.

Exceptional at the full craft — defining the problem, defining the experience requirements, information architecture, and especially data visualization — with enough polish to make it real and compelling.
Someone who wants to obsess over a domain. You want to go deep, and are excited about pushing boundaries in a complex space.
Comfortable with a blank page. As the first design lead, you'll set your own process and build alongside your peers and engineers.

sections.title: Our Mission:
paras: To actively connect people to their next great opportunity.

sections.title: Who We Are:
paras: ZipRecruiter is a leading online employment marketplace. Powered by AI-driven smart matching technology, the company actively connects millions of all-sized businesses and job seekers through innovative mobile, web, and email services, as well as through partnerships with the best job boards on the web. ZipRecruiter has the #1 rated job search app on iOS & Android.

sections.title: Summary:
paras: Every application on ZipRecruiter comes out of two things: what we know about a job seeker, and the flow they go through to apply. The profile holds that knowledge: resume, work history, skills, preferences, and the trade-offs that matter in their job search. The apply flow turns interest in a job into an application an employer can act on. Together they decide how many job seekers who find a job they like go on to apply, and how well each application represents the person behind it.

You will own Product for both. That means deciding what we ask job seekers and when, how we build and keep an accurate picture of each person, and how we get from a job click to a completed, high-quality application with as little effort from the user as possible. The goal is simple to state and hard to deliver: a job seeker should never have to tell us something twice, and every application should show an employer the right reasons to respond.

Few Product roles at ZipRecruiter have more stakeholders. The apply flow is where employer requirements meet the job seeker experience. Employers ask screening questions and rely on applications arriving in their own systems. Trust and safety teams protect the marketplace from fraudulent and low-quality applications. Profile data feeds matching, messaging, and the resume database tools employers use. This is a high-stakes product area where small changes can have outsized impact and there is a huge amount of untapped opportunity for PMs with the ownership and drive to deliver.

sections.title: Key Focuses:
bullets: Act as an Owner: Take full accountability for the job seeker profile and apply flow, from setting KPIs across the funnel to the details of individual screens and questions.

Build the profile job seekers want to keep: Decide what we learn about job seekers, how we learn it, and how we use it to make every later step faster and more accurate. Make the value of a rich profile obvious to the job seeker.

Remove friction from applying: Own conversion from a job click to a started application, and from a started application to a completed one. Know where job seekers drop out, why, and what each question and friction point costs.

Deliver applications employers act on: Partner with employer-side teams on driving application quality, and how applications reach employer systems, so that the most interested and qualified job seekers stand out.

Obsess over your metrics: Apply starts and completions, profile completeness and accuracy, and job seeker retention. You will know how each part of the flow moves them, and you will interrogate the why behind the numbers.
Run on experiments: Design, read, and resolve experiments with judgment about long-term marketplace health, beyond the short-term lift in application volume.

Voice of the Job Seeker: Talk to job seekers, run research, and understand the moment of applying from their side: what they expect, what they will tolerate, and what makes them trust us with their information.
